description: This file contains the implementation of the ColumnChartRenderer class, responsible for rendering column charts within the PDFsharp charting module. It includes methods for initializing renderer info, formatting layout, and drawing the chart components like axes, legend, plot area, and data labels.

classes.name: ColumnChartRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class specialized for rendering column charts, extends ColumnLikeChartRenderer to handle specific layout, initialization, and drawing routines for column chart types.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific information, including chart and axes info, and prepares series data for rendering.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout, axes, and prepares all chart elements for drawing.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Handles the rendering of all chart components: legend, axes, plot area, data labels, gridlines, and border.

methods.name: GetPlotAreaRenderer
methods.description: Returns a specific plot area renderer based on the chart type.

methods.name: GetYAxisRenderer
methods.description: Returns a specific Y-axis renderer based on the chart type.

methods.name: InitSeriesRendererInfo
methods.description: Initializes data needed to render each series of the column chart.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Sets up the visual styles and point information for each series in the chart.
